set.body:
Purpose and scope
Extend the bounded change planner for supported member renames/removals and target changes. Report old/new family closure and propose reference/scans repairs where already supported. Require reviewed plan identity and preserve artifact lineage on moves. Do not expand into participant relabeling or general cross-session scan migration.

Acceptance proof
Tests show target rename updates declarations, member removal produces the specified blocking evidence, stale plan acknowledgment is rejected, accepted old releases export unchanged, and valid changes materialize/re-import coherently. Reference and PostgreSQL lifecycle behavior agrees.

Start here
modules/bids/src/main/scala/sanctity/bids/BidsChangeCompiler.scala; modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/ScientificChanges.scala; modules/app/src/test/scala/sanctity/app/MriLifecycleSuite.scala

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: F4: Carry phase-family rename and removal impact through scientific changes
